name: Error

sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: Six integer context fields (code, category, sourceId, spanStart, spanEnd, causeId) plus the bounded retained contextual message; the public constructor order is listed below.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: Error(code, category, sourceId, spanStart, spanEnd, causeId). code/category/source/span/cause fields preserve their typed integer values. message renders the category; withContext produces contextual messages without overwriting another live Error.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: Owns retained contextual text. Inspection does not publish output; console is an explicit sink.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Invalid spans or argument types reject. Context message capacity is bounded; the current measured pool boundary is 4084 context bytes for the filesystem message prefix. The executed target is x86_64 Linux System V ELF; no foreign ABI layout is implied.

summary: A structured diagnostic value with retained identity and context.
title: Error
